title: Which shapes need a test?
hook: Two triangles share a box. Follow a ray past them.

doesNotKnow: A conservative box miss rules out enclosed shapes, but a box hit only retains candidates.

objective: Explain conservative box rejection while separating candidates from primitive hits.
misconception: A ray that hits a parent box must hit a triangle inside.

claims.text: The ray misses the parent box. How many triangle tests are still needed? 0 / 1 / 2; correct 0.
